scope: Metadata and access-path discovery only; no bulk dataset acquisition was performed.

results.result: The live ArcGIS layer exposes point geometry, service item and layer identifiers, field schema, extent, query formats, advanced-query support and a 2000-record limit.
results.deferred: Count reconciliation, pagination and bounded acquisition tests belong to Step 0.9.

results.result: The live polygon layer exposes detailed 1:100,000 surface-geology attributes, extent, service and source CRS context, query formats and related surface/solid mapping extent layers.
results.deferred: Candidate-area polygon counts and valid-geology coverage belong to Step 0.18.

results.result: The live service exposes separate polyline fault/shear and fold layers, structural taxonomy, source and capture-scale fields, extent and query capabilities.
results.deferred: Geometry validity, density, regional gaps and candidate overlap belong to Step 0.18.

results.result: The Geoscience Australia product record publishes a persistent identifier, exact NetCDF file, WCS, NCSS and OPeNDAP paths, GDA94 extent, cell size, units, lineage and update frequency.
results.deferred: A bounded numeric read, nodata measurement and survey-quality assessment belong to Step 0.19.

results.result: Geoscience Australia publishes the national geophysical-grids WMS, the exact CSCBA layer identifier and an exact NetCDF path for the 2019 complete spherical cap Bouguer anomaly grid.
results.deferred: A bounded numeric read, nodata measurement and effective station-support assessment belong to Step 0.19.

licensing_status: All five pathways remain pending Step 0.8 licence, attribution, raw-redistribution and derived-output classification.
